question.text: If an investor commits Rs. 10 crore into a Cat III AIF issuing units at Rs. 1,000 each, how many units does the investor receive?

explanation.text: The Logic: 10,00,00,000 / 1,000 = 1,00,000 units. The Trap: Other values arise from unit-price errors. Cross-Exam Context: Basic unit allotment arithmetic. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Verify after every drawdown that unit allotment matches committed-capital ratio.
